title: Matrices column reads All once the tier has rules in every Active matrix
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click tier A's row on the Tiers list.
  3. Click the select-all checkbox in the matrix list header.
  4. Type 10 in the bulk bar's value.
  5. Click Set Rule.
  6. Click Set Rule in the dialog.
  7. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Tier A's Matrices column reads 0 over the number of Active matrices (0 of 5 = 0/5).

Step 2:

  • Tier A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • Every matrix row is checked.

Step 4:

  • The value reads 10 with % Off picked.

Step 5:

  • The Set Rule question opens.

Step 6:

  • Every matrix row reads 10% off.

Step 7:

  • Tier A's Matrices column reads All.
